_meta.description: Per-support-type xy scale factors for local position perturbation envelopes. Externalized from perturbation_policy_helpers._SUPPORT_SCALE_BY_TYPE (WS-4 hardcoding audit). Loaded at runtime; the in-code dict is the byte-identical fallback when this file is absent.
_meta.schema: support_scale_by_type[support_type] = [scale_x, scale_y] in (0, 1]; fraction of the clearance-reduced usable support extent over which a child object may be perturbed.
_meta.support_types: Keys must cover every value returned by perturbation_policy_helpers.infer_support_type: contained, cook_surface, shelf_surface, workspace, object_surface.
_meta.behavior: Values are identical to the historical in-code dict; this file changes no behavior. Edit here to retune placement spread per support class.
_meta.curator_process: When infer_support_type() gains a new return value, add a matching key here (and to the in-code fallback) or support_local_envelope will KeyError.
